claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black keyboard with a large “YAMAHA” logo on the front, but no readable model number and no proof of functionality/condition.
Witness photos show a large “YAMAHA” logo on the keyboard front (photo 1/2), not Casio branding.

risks.risk: Wrong brand/model or misrepresentation (seller says Casio, photos show Yamaha). This affects compatibility of parts, value, and buyer confidence.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand/model label on the back/bottom (model number and serial) plus a close-up of the front branding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a worst-case misrepresented keyboard (treat as non-guaranteed brand/model) and value low until identity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Unknown model and features (number of keys, voices/styles, touch sensitivity, ports). Without the model, pricing can be far off.
risks.proof: A photo of the exact model name/number from the label and a screenshot/close-up of the control panel showing model-specific features.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for an unverified Yamaha keyboard model (generic/entry-level) until the model is readable.

risks.risk: May not power on or may have faulty keys/speakers/controls. Photos don’t confirm working condition.
risks.proof: A short video clip: power on, volume up, play several keys across the range, show all main buttons responding, and demonstrate sound output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-tested/possibly non-working (worst-case) until a working demo is provided.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, USB/MIDI cables, etc.). This can make the keyboard unusable or reduce value.
risks.proof: Photos of included items: the exact power adapter/charger (matching voltage/plug), sustain pedal (if any), and any cables/USB/MIDI accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing (worst-case) until the adapter/pedal are confirmed.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not visible in the provided shots (missing/stuck keys, cracks, damaged stand, worn contacts).
risks.proof: A full top-down photo of all keys plus close-ups of the stand joints and any visible wear/damage; ideally a video showing key travel and any sticking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential cosmetic/functional wear (worst-case) until condition is clearly shown.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the brand/model label on the back or bottom (model number + serial).
Send a short video showing the keyboard powering on and producing sound (play left-to-right keys, show volume control, and demonstrate a few buttons).
Confirm what accessories are included: power adapter/charger (photo of the exact adapter), sustain pedal (if any), and any cables/USB/MIDI items.
Provide close-ups of the entire keybed to confirm no missing/stuck keys and show the stand condition (joints/locks).
response.reason: The photos indicate Yamaha branding, but the seller claims Casio, and the exact model and working condition are not verifiable from the provided images. A power-on demo and a readable model/serial label are needed before a reliable price.
